name: zoho-crm
description:
Governed Zoho CRM access for small teams and AI agents. Twelve commands across Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals and any custom module — every write held behind RailCall's approve-then-execute airlock, every change sealed into a signed receipt.

WHO IT'S FOR: teams too small for a compliance function but regulated enough that 'who changed this client record, and who approved it' is a question they will eventually be asked — an eight-person insurance brokerage, a lending desk, a wealth-advisory practice. Also for anyone giving an AI agent write access to CRM and wanting a preview before it commits.

THE PROBLEM: CRM has no undo. A wrong filter on a mass update rewrites 400 client records at 6pm and there is no rollback, only a restore request and an awkward week. Zoho Flow and Zapier will both run that automation; neither can stop it, and neither leaves a tamper-evident record of who authorised it.

READ COMMANDS (no approval needed): verify_connection confirms auth and reports which org and datacenter you are pointed at. describe_module returns every field on a module including custom fields, data types and picklist values — call it first from an agent so writes never guess at field names. search_records runs read-only COQL, Zoho's SQL-like query language, for any 'find the records where...' question. list_records pages through a module. get_record fetches one record by id. list_users returns org users and their ids, which ownership fields require.

WRITE COMMANDS (airlock-gated, preview then approve): create_record and update_record work across any module, batching up to 100 records. upsert_records inserts or updates in place against explicit duplicate-check fields, making re-runs safe. delete_record moves records to the recycle bin, recoverable for 60 days — it never purges. convert_lead turns a qualified Lead into a Contact and Account, optionally opening a Deal. add_note writes an automation's reasoning back onto a record so a human can audit it later.

RELIABILITY: Zoho reports partial failure with HTTP 200, so a batch where 3 of 50 records fail still looks successful to naive tooling. Every write returns succeeded, failed and per-record errors. Rate limits are retried with exponential backoff; writes are never auto-retried after a server error, because Zoho has no idempotency key and a retried create makes duplicates.

QUICK START: create a Self Client at api-console.zoho.com with scopes ZohoCRM.modules.ALL, ZohoCRM.settings.fields.READ and ZohoCRM.users.READ, plus optional ZohoCRM.org.READ, exchange the grant code for a refresh token, then save a vault entry named 'zoho' containing refresh_token, client_id, client_secret, token_url and instance_url. Match the datacenter your org lives in — an Indian org uses accounts.zoho.in and www.zohoapis.in. Run verify_connection first; it tells you immediately whether auth and routing are correct. Secrets stay in the platform vault and are never read from process environment. contest:2026Q3

commands.title: Verify Zoho credentials, routing and reachable org
List the fields on a Zoho CRM module

module.description: Module API name, e.g. Leads, Contacts, Deals, or a custom module.

query.description: COQL SELECT statement. Anything other than SELECT is rejected.

commands.title: Page through records in a module

fields.description: Field api_names to return. Defaults to a core set per module.

commands.title: List org users and their ids

type.description: AllUsers, ActiveUsers, ActiveConfirmedUsers, AdminUsers, CurrentUser and so on. Defaults to ActiveConfirmedUsers.

commands.title: Create records in a Zoho CRM module

records.description: Up to 100 record objects keyed by field api_name.

trigger.description: Which Zoho automations to fire. Empty array suppresses workflow, approval and blueprint.

records.description: Record objects, each of which MUST contain an 'id' plus the fields to change.

commands.title: Insert records, or update in place on duplicate

duplicate_check_fields.description: Field api_names used to detect an existing record, e.g. ["Email"].

commands.title: Move records to the Zoho recycle bin

record_ids.description: Up to 100 numeric Zoho record ids. Records go to the recycle bin, recoverable for 60 days.

commands.title: Convert a Lead to Contact and Account

lead_id.description: Numeric Zoho record id of the Lead.

assign_to.description: Zoho user id to own the resulting records. Use zoho.list_users to resolve one.

deal.description: Supply to also open a Deal. Needs Deal_Name, Closing_Date (YYYY-MM-DD) and Stage.

commands.title: Attach a note to a record

module.description: Module API name of the parent record.
